brief.zh: 三十多个包的仓库，光目录就很长。修好这个 issue，总共不超过 2000 个 token。
brief.en: A repository of over thirty packages, whose file list alone is long. Fix this issue in 2000 tokens all told.

hint.zh: 模型的每次调用都要读一遍整个上下文。
hint.en: Every call of the model reads its whole context again.

after.zh: 目录一旦进了历史，之后每一轮都要再读一遍。没有元件回应它的要目录，模型就换一条路：跑测试，从失败报告里找到文件。给模型的工具少一个，有时反而更省。
after.en: Once the list is in the history, every later turn reads it again. With nothing to answer its ask for the list, the model takes another way: it runs the tests and finds the file in the failing report. One tool fewer is sometimes cheaper.
